en: Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi-story townhouses and commercial buildings. Horse-drawn carts and a few pedestrians move along the street. On the right, a prominent building bears the sign 'STADT DRESDEN.' The title text printed at the top reads 'Frankenberg i. Sa. — Schloßstrasse,' indicating this is a view of Schlossstrasse in Frankenberg in Saxony.
